messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas; Team Boreal kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2025-08-14, changes to the auth gateway require two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off. [constraint; valid 2025-08-14 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-14]
- The ledger depends on the auth gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-17]
- Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-01-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-29]
- The security audit flagged long-lived tokens on the auth gateway. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
- As of 2025-12-23, the pager for the auth gateway rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
- On 2025-09-08, the Team Boreal on-call swapped and Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08]
- INC-2025-017 was an incident affecting the auth gateway on 2025-07-27. [valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- As of 2026-01-22, Team Atlas decided that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour because the security audit flagged long-lived tokens. [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
- On 2026-05-18, the Ember team observed that the auth gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18-2]
- On 2025-12-29, the Ember team observed that the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-12-29-2]
- On 2026-06-18, the Ember team on-call swapped and Diego carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2026-06-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-18]
- On the 2026-02-04 rotation day, Team Dune's on-call swapped and Tomasz Nowak carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-04]
- Team Cinder observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and flagged it since it is not their service. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-21]
- On the 2026-02-12 rotation day, the Ember team on-call swapped and Oskar carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2026-02-12 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-02-12]
    earlier: As of the 2025-12-29 rotation day, Diego is on call for the Ember team, having received the pager from Oskar. [valid 2025-12-29 to 2026-02-12; recorded by standup/ember/2025-12-29]
- On 2025-07-10, the Team Cinder on-call swapped and Yuki carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2025-07-10 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-10]
- As of 2026-05-25, Marcus carries the Team Atlas pager this cycle, having picked up the on-call shift from Priya. [valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-23, Priya is back on the Team Atlas on-call rotation, carrying the pager this cycle. [valid 2026-04-23 to 2026-05-25; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-23]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-09, Priya is off the Team Atlas on-call rotation. [valid 2026-03-09 to 2026-04-23; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-09]
- As of 2026-05-26, the billing service sits with Team Dune; Team Boreal no longer owns it. [valid 2026-05-26 to now; recorded by handover/2026-05-26-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Boreal as of the 2025-03-17 handover. [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal decided the billing service will gate the new invoice flow behind the feature-flags service because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
